criteria.description: Criterion 1: startOrReuseOpenCodeServe starts/reuses headless opencode serve and GET /global/health returns healthy: true.
Criterion 2: GET /session returns valid JSON array of session objects.
Criterion 3: ensureOpenCodeAgentProfile invokes real opencode agent create --mode subagent --permissions read,glob,grep and openCodeAgentFileMatchesPermissions validates generated frontmatter.
Criterion 4: Restricted agent profile explicitly sets bash: deny, edit: deny, webfetch: deny, refusing denied actions.
